video_title: Can the KNICKS repeat? Josh Smith joins the BAHA. Breaking down the EAST and more

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on his Knicks prediction and the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: I was right about the Knicks, I was right about the Dominican Republic, I was wrong about the Cavs.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Smith
text_blocks.text: I was right about the Knicks, I was right about the Dominican Republic, I was wrong about the Cavs. Ray was wrong about the Pistons. Can I get my flowers? We should have led with flowers. I am not understanding why I am getting smoke instead of my flowers.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You are right, you are right, you are right.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on his decision to leave the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I took a lot of heat for not playing basketball and calling for Tom Thibodeau's firing.
quotes.quote: I took a lot of heat for not playing basketball and calling for Tom Thibodeau's firing. I just knew that he was not the guy. We got rid of him and in year one we turned Mike Brown into a winner. I am not disrespecting, but I called it. When I seen us in trouble with what Mike Brown was doing, I took the matters into my own hands and went to Atlanta.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith ranks Jalen Brunson in the top five
quotes.excerpt: I think Jalen Brunson is top ten now.
quotes.quote: I think Jalen Brunson is top ten now.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on Jalen Brunson's impact on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the X-factor for that team.
quotes.quote: I think he is the X-factor for that team. No matter how you put it. All big games, he showed up. Think about them threes he was making in the corner in one of the last games with the Spurs. Contested threes falling down, getting the tip-in. He is a capable free-throw shooter now, right? So it is just things like that.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on the Knicks' need for a second shot creator
quotes.excerpt: I have been saying they need a second shot creator/playmaker.
quotes.quote: For the entire year I have been saying they need a second shot creator/playmaker. I can create a new one if needed. Much love to Memphis as well, man. Big shout out to Memphis.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on Jalen Brunson's scoring ability
quotes.excerpt: You can't score two points, Jalen, and we win.
quotes.quote: This is why I give Jalen Brunson all the credit I give him because you can't score two points, Jalen, and we win. Your name is Michael Jalen Brunson, and this is the dynasty right here. You are looking at the wrong thing. The skinny guy that can't laugh, the only lucky person last year was Wemby, lasting through the whole playoffs and stuff like that. You know he is built like a push broom.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on the Knicks' playoff run
quotes.excerpt: We won the chip in convincing fashion.
quotes.quote: We won the chip in convincing fashion. They said we won by like the widest margin, right? Right? Do you know we did that with our best defensive, our defensive anchor not being able to be on the floor because they just fouled him on purpose? Jalen Brunson is so good that people's defensive, your defensive strategy was to foul Mitchell Robinson instead of us having a regular.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith on the Knicks' potential to repeat
quotes.excerpt: It is going to be very hard to repeat because we all know how hard it is.
quotes.quote: It is going to be very hard to repeat because we all know how hard it is to repeat. It is not an easy thing to do because you got to fight the complacency, you got to fight the I did it already. Knowing what Jalen Brunson, Michael Bridges, and Josh Hart, the way they operate, I don't see it being outlandish that they could get there again because the simple fact, they are competitors and there is no one else in the East that I really fear that should.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson questions if any team has everyone in their prime
quotes.excerpt: When's the last time we seen a team like the Knicks have everyone in their prime at the same time?
quotes.quote: When's the last time we seen a team like the Knicks have everyone in their prime at the same time?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Knicks' championship window being very short
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks window to win another championship is very short.
quotes.quote: There's certain things that we say everything changes and I think the more I think about it, I'm low-key with until they get beat. I don't know if somebody can beat them because the difference between Oklahoma City is because you had their emergence of Cason Wallace this year. This was Cason's first playoff, wasn't it? The Knicks window to win another championship is very short.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson bets on the Knicks' core players to perform
quotes.excerpt: I'm willing to bet on Josh Hart, Mitchell, and OG and Shamet and Jordan Clarkson.
quotes.quote: I'm willing to bet on Josh Hart, Mitchell, and OG and Shamet and Jordan Clarkson. You know what Jalen Brunson going to do. You see what Karl-Anthony Towns can do and you add an Andre Drummond. You got a lot of proven players who aren't going to go out there and do some outlandish shit. They're not going to go out there and play outside of themselves just to be like, 'All right, I did this last year, I'm going to show you what I can do this year.' Josh Hart going to do the same thing he's done his whole career.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Jalen Brunson's next contract determining the Knicks' dynasty
quotes.excerpt: What Jalen Brunson does with his next contract determines if it's going to be a real dynasty or not.
quotes.quote: The only problem is what Jalen Brunson does with his next contract. That determines if it's going to be a real dynasty or not. Because determining how much money he takes, that's going to because I tell you this, how old is OG? If he's 28 to 29 years old, him and Mitchell can get one more big contract.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Knicks' inability to pay all their players
quotes.excerpt: You're not going to be able to pay all these guys.
quotes.quote: You're not going to be able to pay all these guys. Once y'all run out and it's time to pay y'all again, see you later, go somewhere else. We are welcoming the supermax. This is New York. People want to come here, pay them.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Knicks being the perfect championship team
quotes.excerpt: The team matters. There's the perfect makeup for a championship team.
quotes.quote: The team matters. There's the perfect makeup for a championship team. You have the perfect makeup.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on why the Knicks are not welcoming Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: All that Kevin Durant shit, that's why we're not welcoming him right now.
quotes.quote: All that Kevin Durant shit, that's why we're not welcoming him right now. He out here looking for a team. Yeah, guess what, you can't come here. Because New York ain't never been cool to be. Now, guess what, you see what's happening. I'm on the top of buildings, walking through the city, Brunson. Everybody want to be a part of that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on what the Heat need to do to reach the Knicks' level
quotes.excerpt: What do the Heat have to do to get to the Knicks to get to what we think Philly to get to that level?
quotes.quote: What do the Heat have to do to get to the Knicks to get to what we think Philly to get to that level? What do they need to do?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Heat needing to fill out their roster
quotes.excerpt: I feel like that's three people that play defense. It kind of starts there.
quotes.quote: I feel like that's three people that play defense. It kind of starts there. You see who want to chip, not to milk it. But yeah, you see who want to chip and I feel like you need three players, Giannis, Bam, and Jimmy. And they need to fill out the rest of the roster. Like you said they still got Wiggins. Get some shooters and you right in it because if if Philly ends up matching up with Miami on some four five, who's stopping Giannis on Philly?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Heat lacking a go-to creator
quotes.excerpt: They don't have a guy you can throw the ball to go create.
quotes.quote: They don't have a guy you can throw the ball to go create. If you're if you're like now if you're developing Davion Mitchell to be that, when you're in the playoffs, you need a guy you can throw the ball to and say go get us a bucket.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on why he likes the Heat
quotes.excerpt: I like Miami and it's really because I do like Bam Adebayo.
quotes.quote: I like Miami and it's really because I do like Bam Adebayo. I put a lot into he's a three and D kind of player that y'all are talking about. But I also see him like really working on his bag. Every summer after summer he gets better offensively every year too. So with Giannis and Bam, I feel like that's a three there's three people that play defense.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Heat needing shooters
quotes.excerpt: Get some shooters and you right in it.
quotes.quote: Get some shooters and you right in it because if if Philly ends up matching up with Miami on some four five, who's stopping Giannis on Philly? Brunson playing the four? Yeah. What's wrong with that? That's 30 and 15 for Giannis. He's not going to stop him. He's not going to stop him. But you don't like with Giannis like you just sending crowds at him. Yeah. You got it. Yeah. And I don't think Miami has enough shooting.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the importance of stars in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: It matters having Jalen Brunson. It matters having Karl-Anthony Towns.
quotes.quote: It matters having Jalen Brunson. It matters having Karl-Anthony Towns. It matters having guys who have been there that can go win you a game. If you don't have that, majority of the time you're not going to win no championship.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on LeBron James' defensive capabilities
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is capable of guarding anybody.
quotes.quote: LeBron is capable of guarding anybody. You're going to act like LeBron never had to guard nobody. So, DeRozan is nobody. Paul George is nobody. Yeah, out there. So, it's not like these people are your assignments because you have Shane Battier and people like that your whole career to kind of to shump it on Cleveland. But if you out there with all the pick and rolls and shit that's going on and you mean to tell me LeBron's not guarding nobody? He's not striving down when he has to in order to make all of these finals? It's irresponsible.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Jalen Brunson being a better defender than Tony Allen
quotes.excerpt: You think LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen?
quotes.quote: You think LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen? He's had to defend more than Tony Allen, yes.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the difficulty of team construction under the new CBA
quotes.excerpt: The way this CBA is constructed, it's just not possible.
quotes.quote: The way this CBA is constructed, it's just not possible. It's way harder now. Like you you you got to do some real real team construction at this point.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson predicts the Knicks will be a top three seed
quotes.excerpt: Knicks top three seed this year.
quotes.quote: Knicks top three seed this year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Knicks' goal of being a top seed
quotes.excerpt: Definitely top three. We're not going to aim for one because we see what happens to one.
quotes.quote: Definitely top three. We're not going to aim for one because we see what happens to one. You know, one flames out, you you you get hurt, somebody is hurt from playing so hard all year. No, we going to coast as long as we top four seeds, we back in the finals.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith disputes the claim that the Knicks and Warriors are equal
quotes.excerpt: They're not equal. Who said they were equal? Josh said they're equal.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: They're not equal. Who said they were equal? Josh said they're equal.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Smith
text_blocks.text: Josh said they're equal. And you were condoning it.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith evaluates a potential contract for Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: I'm okay with 190. That's still a lot. That's still a lot.
quotes.quote: I'm okay with 190. That's still a lot. That's still a lot.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith praises the Knicks' offensive adjustment involving Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: I think the KAT offense worked really well for them.
quotes.quote: I think the KAT offense worked really well for them.

quotes.speaker: Josh Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Smith dismisses the idea that the Western Conference is superior
quotes.excerpt: Please stop overrating the West, it's getting old.
quotes.quote: Please stop overrating the West, it's getting old.
